Open Pattern Lab

Growth, horns and independent pigments

Release 20261022-12 · original teaching model. This finite audit checks game behavior, not real animal biology.

1,600 controlled battles

Each row uses 100 fixed decision seeds and repeats each seed with corners swapped: 200 matches per comparison. Numerical traits start at their midpoint; growth starts neutral unless changed for the named build. Tiny/huge differ by body growth alone. The agile build adds tracking, tactics, turning, edge sense and attention while reducing strength. The power build adds size, strength and mass but reduces turning, tactics and attention. Extended appendage builds change one growth modifier.

Larger bodies beat otherwise similar smaller bodies slightly more often in these trials, but an agile smaller build won against the huge build more often. Horns and long appendages did not guarantee victory. No universal balance claim follows from a limited sample.

Inheritance and rarity checks

Six growth dimensions stayed within 0.035 log2 units of parental contributions when mutation was disabled. Selecting from 20 offspring per brood for 160 rounds could produce body growth greater than 3× or below 0.34× baseline, without mutation. These are deliberate long breeding programs; ordinary broods do not jump to those extremes.

20,000 default-rate births from single-horn parents produced fewer than 20 new double-horn carriers and no triple horns. Triples require a double-horn allele in the line or a later adjacent mutation. Across the six growth modifiers, fewer than 20 deviations exceeded 0.08 log2 units, and every such deviation recorded a mutation. Hidden leg and thorax colors reappeared in 1,200 mutation-free births independently of the body color.

Compatibility and display checks

Original seven-chromosome DNA, pending-trade fingerprints, and old SUMO4 physics are preserved. New shared matches use SUMO5. The services accept old packets, preserve new growth and pigment records, and reject mismatched battle versions. Archives store appearance snapshots without playable genomes. New portraits are fitted inside adaptive bounds; the inspector remains visible when its details scroll.

Reproduce the battle table with node tools/audit-growth.cjs. Run node --test tests/*.test.cjs for the full check suite. Results are also available as raw JSON. The earlier SUMO4 audit remains available as a historical comparison.
